[On Use] For this turn: when hit by an enemy, inflict 2 [img:Tremor.png] Tremor [img:Tremor.png] TremorWhen hit by attacks that trigger Tremor Burst, raise the Stagger Threshold by X. Lasts Y turn(s). on target next turn (6 times per turn)
